title: Concept: Magnetic-stripe track data in a response
description: Magnetic-stripe track 2 data in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Track 2 carries the primary account number, the expiry and the service code in one string, which is everything a card-present terminal needs and the data the card networks forbid storing.
applicability: Deployments that render magnetic-stripe track 2 data into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Track 2 carries the primary account number, the expiry and the service code in one string, which is everything a card-present terminal needs and the data the card networks forbid storing.
